portability_restrictions: Commercial use restrictions in Llama 3 Community License
No redistribution of weights without Meta approval
evidence.license_commercial_restrictions: Restricts use for commercial services with >700M monthly active users; prohibits use to improve other LLMs

impact.description: Gated models require access request (manual approval), creating friction for portability. Llama 3 Community License restricts commercial deployment at scale and prohibits using model outputs to train other LLMs. Weights are downloadable (safetensors) but license terms limit true portability and reuse. No native export of fine-tuned adapters/weights from HF Inference Providers back to user-controlled infrastructure.

remediation.notes: License restrictions are upstream (Meta); HF enforces gating but cannot change license terms
